Here are the primary developer projects and repositories for continuing your research into running the **Opal C1** on macOS without the official Composer app:

Core Open-Source Alternative

[![Opal C1](data:image/png;base64,)

[Opal C1

](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:8230903966519850577,headlineOfferDocid:15749056137320718173,productDocid:15749056137320718173&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiy7Kyz8L6XAxXmPkQIHX8qJQAQgLcPegYIAAgREAE)

**[cansik/open-opal on GitHub](https://github.com/cansik/open-opal)**: This is the primary open-source framework built specifically to interface with the [Opal C1](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:8230903966519850577,headlineOfferDocid:15749056137320718173,productDocid:15749056137320718173&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiy7Kyz8L6XAxXmPkQIHX8qJQAQxa4PegYIAAgREAo) hardware.
- **Mac Specifics:** It includes standalone proof-of-concept software and an OBS streaming demo binary compiled specifically for **macOS arm64 (Apple Silicon)**.
- **Capabilities:** It provides explicit code samples utilizing the underlying depthai engine to directly manage autofocus loops, manual lens distances, white balance, and access the raw uncompressed 4K video stream via Python. [[1](https://github.com/cansik/open-opal/), [2](https://www.reddit.com/r/opalcamera/comments/1196wrc/any_api_documentation_for_the_opal_c1/)]

Hardware API & Underlying Layer Architecture

- **[luxonis/depthai-core on GitHub](https://github.com/luxonis/depthai-core)**: Because the [Opal C1](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,imageDocid:8230903966519850577,headlineOfferDocid:15749056137320718173,productDocid:15749056137320718173&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiy7Kyz8L6XAxXmPkQIHX8qJQAQxa4PegYIAAgYEAQ) is structurally an Intel Myriad X VPU device designed around Luxonis architecture, this repository contains the raw C++ core and drivers required to boot code onto the device's RAM. If you are building custom local automated scripts to communicate with the hardware over USB upon a macOS system reboot, you will use their depthai-core library infrastructure. [[1](https://www.reddit.com/r/opalcamera/comments/1196wrc/any_api_documentation_for_the_opal_c1/)]
- **[luxonis/depthai-python on GitHub](https://github.com/luxonis/depthai-python)**: This repository hosts the native Python bindings for the hardware engine. This is the optimal starting point if you plan to write a minimal, lightweight local shell script or daemon on your Mac to automatically lock the webcam's focal parameters to a standard manual distance every time the USB connection resets.

If you want, I can help you write a quick terminal **launchd plist script** for macOS that detects when your Opal C1 connects and automatically triggers one of these open-source tools in the background. Would that streamline your workflow?
